Container.Name: TranscribeR
Container.Overview: Web UI for transcribing audio through a llama-swap hosted speech-to-text model (whisper.cpp, Nemotron/llama-server audio models, faster-whisper, etc). Long files are chunked automatically, speakers are detected on the CPU and can be named. Upload audio (auto converted to MP3), follow a synced timestamped transcript while it plays, edit it inline, review segments flagged as uncertain, and export plain text, timestamped text, SRT, VTT or JSON.
Container.Requires: A running llama-swap instance with a transcription model configured (endpoint /v1/audio/transcriptions).

Config.Name: llama-swap URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your llama-swap server (no trailing /v1)

Config.Name: Default model
Config.Description: Model name from your llama-swap config. Users can pick any model in the UI.

Config.Name: llama-swap API key
Config.Description: Only if llama-swap is configured with apiKeys

Config.Name: Default language
Config.Description: ISO code like en. Empty = auto detect

Config.Name: Upstream format
Config.Description: Format sent to the model: mp3, or wav (16kHz mono) if your backend cannot decode mp3

Config.Name: Speaker detection
Config.Description: Default for the Speakers selector: off, auto, or a fixed number of speakers. Runs on the CPU.

Config.Name: Chunk seconds
Config.Description: Long audio is split at pauses into chunks of about this length (keeps each request inside the model's context). 0 = send whole file.

Config.Name: Chunk concurrency
Config.Description: Chunks sent to llama-swap in parallel. Raise only if your llama-server has multiple slots (--parallel).

Config.Name: Transcription API
Config.Description: auto, chat or transcriptions. auto uses chat completions (gives word confidence) for audio-capable llama-server models.

Config.Name: Chat prompt
Config.Default: Transcribe the speech in this audio verbatim. Output only the transcript text.
Config.Description: Instruction sent with each chunk in chat mode

Container.Config: Transcribe the speech in this audio verbatim. Output only the transcript text.

Config.Name: Speaker threshold
Config.Description: Clustering threshold for Auto speaker count. Higher = fewer speakers. Lower it if different people get merged.

Config.Name: Speaker CPU threads
Config.Description: CPU threads used for speaker detection

Config.Name: Request timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for one chunk

Config.Name: Uncertainty threshold
Config.Description: Default segment confidence below which a segment is flagged (adjustable in UI)

Config.Name: Word threshold
Config.Description: Word probability below which a word is underlined
